Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. results.content:
President Donald Trump’s job approval rating in Alabama remains above water, though it has declined from the high point he reached at the start of his second term, according to the latest tracking data from Civiqs.

The survey shows 53% of Alabama voters approve of Trump’s job performance, while 40% disapprove. Another 8% said they neither approve nor disapprove.
